## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`.venv/bin/pytest`), new behaviour has a test
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.de.md` updated (section "Unreleased")
- [ ] New or changed texts in `strings.json` and in **both** translations (`en.json`, `de.json`), same placeholders
- [ ] Panel texts in both languages
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`/`README.de.md`, `website/`) updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Tested with real devices (which radio module, which devices?) – or say why not
- [ ] No real device addresses, serial numbers or IP addresses in tests or docs
